coverageContext: Published complete 858-term gene-based PRS-CSx research model evaluated in African American COGA, SAGE and Yale-Penn cohorts (6,315 participants). The original posterior weights are retained. EUR ranks are withheld; the separate European study used only 847 terms and does not validate this complete model there. Published analyses adjusted for sex, ancestry PCs, cohort and family structure where applicable. Important source discrepancy: Catalog labels OR 1.76 as top 10% versus rest, while the primary article's methods, results and Table 3 specify top versus bottom decile. GA does not apply either odds ratio to a person. Not a diagnosis, drinking-behavior forecast, character judgment or treatment guide.
